locations.notes: User-level git config (name, email, aliases, defaults) — plain INI, small enough to eyeball. May contain credential.helper settings pointing at a store; review for credential-adjacent lines before reapplying. Non-JSON so the engine passes it through, never auto-trusted.

Private keys, known_hosts, agent sockets — credential material per the taxonomy (like cookie/token blobs). Never blind-restored: exported separately through an encrypted channel or Castle, reapplied only as a deliberate decision, not as part of a bulk restore.

Linux git is a system package-manager install — no user-writable binary dir. On Windows, Git for Windows can also install per-user under LocalAppData; that is a full binary install and is reinstalled clean via Chocolatey, never carried across.
